answers: We're Lumen Ledger, a B2B SaaS company. We sell AP-automation software to mid-market finance teams, priced per seat per month on annual or multi-year contracts.

Products: Core (invoice capture and approvals) and Pro (adds payments and ERP sync). Our cost drivers are cloud hosting per seat (roughly $6/seat/month, illustrative), payment-processing pass-through on Pro, and onboarding/implementation hours (about 20 hours per new customer).

Tiers: STANDARD for new logos, PREFERRED for renewals, STRATEGIC for enterprise accounts over 500 seats. Margins: STANDARD target 80%, min 65%, never below 55%; PREFERRED 78/62/52; STRATEGIC 72/55/45. Example customers: Northbeam Logistics (STRATEGIC), Cedar & Pine Dental Group (PREFERRED), Brightwater Clinics (STANDARD) — all fictional.

We'll trade price for: a 12-month or longer commitment (about 4 points), paying annually upfront (about 3 points), committing to 200+ seats (about 3 points), and a case study / logo rights (about 1 point). NET60 costs us about 2 points. Auto-approve up to $500k total contract value. Tone: crisp, consultative, no hype.
